description: What variotrip is and how it works, in the shop’s own words: one mobile-data eSIM for the whole route, one shared data pool, the trip length, ranges, delivery, payment, hotspot, activation, top-ups (data, days or a country), router activation, e-mails, support. Use for any question that is not a price.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. en-gb, de-de (sets currency and link locale). Defaults from language.

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, ja. Localizes country names and sets the language/currency of links and prices.
